newsitem.title: USA: Keystone trims buyback to 1.2 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Keystone trims buyback to 1.2 mln shares.

text.p: Keystone Financial Inc said on Thursday it would amend its share buyback program and limit the repurchase to 1.2 million shares.
The company said in a statement that when the program was announced in November 1995 the board of directors had authorized the buy back of up to 1.5 million shares.
The change was made "to satisfy the pooling of interests accounting requirements associated with the recently announced acquisition of Financial Trust Corp," the statement said.
The repurchase program will end no later than the closing date of the Financial Trust merger. The merger is expected to be completed in the first half of 1997.

In a separate action, the board also authorized the repurchase of up to 1.5 million additional shares of Keystone common stock for issuance in the acquisition of First Financial Corp of Western Maryland.
Keystone has about 38 million shares outstanding.
